title: Minimum Number Of Arrows To Burst Balloons
description:
Each balloon spans a closed interval `[start, end]` on the x-axis. A vertical arrow shot at position `x` bursts every balloon whose interval contains `x`. Return the minimum number of arrows needed to burst all balloons.

## Examples

```text
Input: points = [[10,16],[2,8],[1,6],[7,12]]
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: points = [[1,2],[2,3],[3,4],[4,5]]
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= points.length <= 10^5`
- Each interval is `[start,end]` with `start < end`
- `-2^31 <= start < end <= 2^31 - 1`
